About this figure

Projected physical separation of dual-AGN candidates against redshift (bottom axis) and lookback time (upper axis). The red highest-density-region contours enclose 50 / 80 / 95 / 99% of the DESI DR1 dual-AGN candidates with rp < 50 kpc (Gaussian KDE in log z – log rp, bw = 0.18, clipped below the 1.6″ resolution curve). Fiber-incompleteness (PIP) weighting raises the effective DESI count to .

Literature comparison: spatially resolved dual AGN after the notebook’s BigMAC cleaning (z valid, ST1 > −1, double-peaked/fiber-only Sep=2″–3″ entries removed), and candidates before that exclusion (dashed histogram).

Full details of the sample and its selection are in the paper: arXiv:2607.27390.
